summary: Backend-only regression on the new FreePress API (custom JWT + argon2 via pwdlib). 26/26 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL. All specified scenarios verified: register (client/reporter, 409 dup), login for seeded admin/reporter/reader plus 401 on wrong password, /auth/me 401 without token, public feed & reporters expose arrays with no _id leak, reporter can create + list + delete own posts (403 for reader, 403 across reporters, admin can delete any), provider-gated endpoints (/support, /live/token, /media/upload-url) return 503 with a friendly 'coming soon' message rather than 500, /reports creates moderation record, /reports/{id}/resolve enforces admin (403 for non-admin, 200 for admin) and returns 404 on second resolve, and admin routes (overview, users, disable/enable/verify) require admin role with admin unable to disable self (400). Disabled account login correctly returns 403.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event startup/shutdown which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
public_user() omits verified default correctly, and all response filters exclude _id — good.
provider_required() surfaces integration hints in the 503 detail; matches the 'coming soon' contract.
current_user() re-issues 401 when the DB user's role diverges from the token — good defensive check after admin role changes.
seed_data() is idempotent per-email; safe on repeated startups.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ users, posts, and moderation reports created via API during test run (prefixed TEST). No cleanup endpoint invoked; records remain but are isolated by TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://reporter-hub-11.preview.emergentagent.com. Auth is JWT bearer via pwdlib argon2. Seeded users: admin@freepress.in/admin123, rhea@freepress.in/reporter123, reader@freepress.in/reader123. Provider integrations (Mux, LiveKit, Razorpay) intentionally return 503 'coming soon' until keys are added to backend/.env. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL set.
